entities.name: Etali
entities.description: An elder dinosaur of Ixalan called "the hurricane", a manifestation of red mana; compleated by the Copper Host and killed by Zacama.

entities.name: Zetalpa
entities.description: An elder dinosaur whose talons tore Etali's dorsal sail in a fight.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: An elder dinosaur who bit off Etali's arm and head.

entities.name: Copper Host
entities.description: Green-aligned Phyrexian group that compleated Etali.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city whose opening revealed the elder dinosaurs.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Etali was compleated.
